data.description:
## Description

**What**: Update all in-tree documentation that references the old bash runner or `llm-api-call.sh` to reflect the new Python module layout. Add a deprecation note for `llm-api-call.sh` in release notes. Optionally add a thin compat wrapper that warns and forwards to the Python entry-point for one minor version (removed in S7).

**Why**: SC1 documentation portion. After S3 lands, docs that describe the old bash architecture become stale immediately. CLAUDE.md's Architecture section, CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md, ci-overlay-flags.md, and onboarding/SKILL.md all reference the runner and need to be updated for future agent context to be correct.

**Scope**:
- IN: Update CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md (new module layout, new config keys); update ci-overlay-flags.md (overlay dispatch in Python); update onboarding/SKILL.md (where it references the runner); update CLAUDE.md "Architecture" section (Python module replacing bash orchestration); deprecation note for llm-api-call.sh in release notes; optional thin compat wrapper for one minor version (with deprecation warning printed on invocation).
- OUT: Removing the compat wrapper at end of deprecation window (S7); enumerating live code consumers (S2.5 already covers in-tree code consumers); design notes / ADRs (only if pre-existing — no new ADRs unless Architecture Board mandates).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md, ci-overlay-flags.md, onboarding/SKILL.md, and CLAUDE.md "Architecture" section all reflect the new `dso_ci_review/` module layout. References to `llm-api-call.sh` are removed or replaced with module references; references to `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` describe the shim semantics and the underlying module.
  ← Satisfies: "References in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md, ci-overlay-flags.md, and onboarding/SKILL.md updated to reflect the new module layout"
- When this story is complete, the release notes for the version that ships this epic include an explicit deprecation note for `llm-api-call.sh`, naming the replacement Python entry-point and the deprecation window for any compat wrapper added.
  ← Satisfies: out-of-tree-consumer deprecation signal (red-team residual-references mitigation)

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Out-of-tree consumers calling `llm-api-call.sh` will break on next pull when S3 deletes it; the deprecation note is the only signal they receive. If a thin compat wrapper is added, it must print a deprecation warning to stderr on every invocation, naming the replacement and the removal window. S7 will remove the wrapper at end of window.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a future agent, project documentation reflects the new Python module layout and llm-api-call.sh has a deprecation note
